newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE Nov commodity volume down on previous month.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE Nov commodity volume down on previous month.

text.p: Turnover in commodity futures and options traded on the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) slipped slightly by 1,304 lots to 306,315 in November from the previous month, a LIFFE report showed.

Cocoa futures, as usual, were the most actively traded item and turnover bucked the downward trend, rising to 138,505 lots in the month from a previous 119,303. Cocoa options volume fell to 4,041 lots from 4,148 lots.
In robusta coffee, the second most active futures contract, volume fell to 86,131 lots in November from 99,647 in October.
The total volume of 306,315 lots was down on the year-ago period when it totalled 327,186 lots, the LIFFE report said.
The cumulative January-November total of 3.62 million lots was below the 3.57 million recorded in the same period of 1995.
